say:1:1060502001:1.text: Hey! Are you afraid of the mana sprite?
say:1:1060502001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，你来得正好！你……你害怕魔花种子吗？
say:1:1060502001:1.male: Hey! Are you afraid of the mana sprite?

say:3:1060502002:1.text: Just those hopping creatures up ahead!
say:3:1060502002:1.source_cn: 就是前面那些蹦蹦跳跳的魔花啊！

say:4:1060502004:1.text: They blocked the main road. I-I can't even go over there... but I've got to head back to Lunadorf in a hurry...
say:4:1060502004:1.source_cn: 它们待在大路上，我、我不敢过去……可是我又得赶紧回月湖村……

say:5:1060502005:1.text: Could you help, outlander? Just hustle them back to the bush! No need to hurt them.
say:5:1060502005:1.source_cn: 异乡人，你能帮帮我吗？不用伤害它们，只要把它们赶回花丛...

say:7:1060502006:1.text: I'm just trying to stay away... so I specifically learned about their habit.
say:7:1060502006:1.source_cn: 这不是为了尽量避开它们吗……我特意去了解了它们的习性。

say:8:1060502007:1.text: So many mana sprites popped out. That means there must be manafleur clusters—likely within the Bizarre Labyrinth.
say:8:1060502007:1.source_cn: 一下出现了这么多魔花种子，说明附近肯定有魔花花丛，看样...

say:9:1060502008:1.text: Please, hustle them back. Otherwise, I'll have to take a long walk to get back to Lunadorf!
say:9:1060502008:1.source_cn: 拜托了，帮我把它们赶回去吧。不然我只有绕一大圈才能回到...

say:11:1060502003:1.text: Ugh, right... The mana sprite is my worst nightmare.
say:11:1060502003:1.source_cn: 唉……没错，魔花种子是我最怕的东西。
